craft_notes: Sthāyin: was-joy (certainty). Close: certainty. Rejected: 'void' for abhāva — killed: non-being kept; 'faith' for niścaya — killed: certainty kept.

lines: Non-being goes to be-becomeness, and undelusion is not there;
since, from contact's application — then thus was certainty.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nābhāvo bhāvyatām eti na ca tatrāsty amūḍhatā | yato 'bhiyogasaṃsparśāt tadāsid iti niścayah

reads_against.argmap: Non-being goes to be-becomeness, yet no undelusion there; since contact's application — then thus certainty was.
c1_essence: Non-being to be-becomeness; no undelusion; contact-certainty was.
